normative_extracts.quote: The SubtleCrypto interface provides a set of cryptographic primitives executed in native code over secure contexts, returning Promises so heavy key derivation and signing never block the main thread.

browser_support.notes: Requires Secure Context (HTTPS or localhost). Ed25519 is Baseline Newly Available.

pipeline_phases: Native C++ Crypto Backend (BoringSSL / NSS / CommonCrypto)
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: SubtleCrypto dispatches cryptographic operations off the JS thread to the browser's native C++ crypto library and isolates raw key bytes behind opaque CryptoKey handles.

production_failures.symptom: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'digest') on an HTTP staging domain
production_failures.root_cause: window.crypto.subtle is undefined in non-secure (http://) contexts other than localhost.
production_failures.mitigation: Serve all environments over HTTPS or guard with window.isSecureContext.

production_failures.symptom: AES-GCM ciphertext forged or corrupted silently when reusing an IV
production_failures.root_cause: Reusing the same 96-bit initialization vector (IV) with the same AES-GCM key leaks XOR differences and breaks authentication.
production_failures.mitigation: Generate a fresh 12-byte IV via crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12)) for every encrypt() call.
